rows.en:
(Still, hitting on girls again...
I'll have to rat him out to Klan-senpai later.)

Sure, I don't mind...
Are you going to check out some new shop again?
So, what did you want to talk to me about?
(It's rare for Michel-kun to hesitate like this...)

...What's gotten into you all of a sudden,
Michel-kun? Did I do something
to deserve your thanks?

Yeah, that goes without saying.
And I'm counting on you too.

(Hmm, I don't really get it, but if Michel-kun's
satisfied, I guess that's fine...)

Well then, might I interest you in a date
with your humble servant, somewhere more fun?
As thanks for everything so far.
Okay, then let's have a blast!
Then, your hand, if you please, princess.

(Getting thanked by Michel-kun
was a little embarrassing.)

(I hope Michel-kun and I can keep
having a good time like this from now on...)

(Okay, today's classes are over.
Guess I'll head home soon.)

Yo, \p.
If you're free, let's go to Silver Moon or something.
rows.notes: Both genders. Silver Moon is provisional in locations.json.

rows.en:
Having tea with you like this
isn't half bad, you know.

Huh?
You suddenly invited me to tea, so I wondered
what was up... What's gotten into you, Michel?
Nothing. Just that I hope days like this keep going.
Geez, what a boring reaction.
rows.notes: Both genders; answers the player's flat 'haa...'.

rows.en: Well, let's enjoy an elegant tea time.

(Like Michel said,
I hope days like this keep going...)

(Okay, today's classes are over.
Maybe I'll head home soon.)

Huh?
You suddenly invited me to tea, so I wondered what
was up... What's gotten into you, Michel-kun?

(Like Michel-kun said,
I hope days like this keep going...)

By the way, Michel, I heard a rumor
that you've stopped hitting on girls lately.
Is it true?

No, that's news to me...
There's a rumor like that going around?
Oh, so it's just a rumor after all.

No, it's not just a rumor.
I really don't hit on girls anymore.

Even I've found someone
I'd risk my life to protect.

(Huh, so Michel's finally decided
to be honest with himself...)
rows.notes: Male. The player assumes he means Klan.

rows.en:
I realized it. The person who matters most to me
was right by my side all along...

So... will you go out with me?
...............\p?
rows.notes: Both genders. Another fake confession (joke revealed at c10238).

rows.en:
My love went missing in action, and I'd been
searching for it... You're the one who found it...
rows.notes: Both genders. yukue fumei de tansakuchuu = MIA, search under way (military image).

rows.en: Wha?! Huh? Y-you're serious...?

...Hey, come on!
Of course it's a joke. Quit falling for it every time.
Huh?! What? A-a joke...?
Ugh... I got fooled yet again......
Well, the part about liking you is true, though.
I'm counting on you from here on too, partner.
rows.notes: Both genders. ore no paatonaa = 'my partner'; possessive folded into the address.

rows.en:
Affinity ending.
Filler for Michel (female).

Affinity ending.
Filler for Michel (male).

By the way, Michel-kun, I heard a rumor
that you've stopped hitting on girls lately.
Is it true?
Oh, so it's just a rumor after all.

(Huh, so Michel-kun's finally decided
to be honest with himself...)

(Okay, all that's left is to go home,
but just heading straight home seems kinda...)
(Oh, there's Michel. Perfect timing.)
Michel, want to go to Folmo or something?

Sorry, \p.
I've got something to take care of after this.
Ask me again some other time.
I see. Well, that can't be helped...
Sorry about that.
rows.notes: x10: Michel in frd_mcl_101/102 and nml_mcl_021 (apologising for leaving with Klan); both genders.

rows.en:
(Oh well.
Guess I'll go shopping at Folmo by myself...)

(Okay, all that's left is to go home,
but just heading straight home seems kinda...)
(Oh, there's Michel-kun. Perfect timing.)
Michel-kun, want to go to Folmo or something?
I see. Well, that can't be helped...

(Oh well.
Maybe I'll go shopping at Folmo by myself...)

Michel,
want to go to a hot dog joint or something?

(Oh well.
Guess I'll go eat hot dogs by myself...)

Michel-kun,
want to go to a hot dog joint or something?

(Oh well.
Maybe I'll go eat hot dogs by myself...)
